title: The Ordinary Blue Hour
author: Elodie Nakamura
blurb: Yara Sandoval, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must return to the place where the story went wrong before the mother's memory goes entirely.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
